testcases.name: nemotron-h-nano-9b
testcases.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.
testcases.notes: The reference runs the checkpoint's documented original PyTorch implementation in BF16 with Transformers 5.5.0, causal-conv1d 1.6.2.post1, and mamba-ssm 2.3.2.post1. TensorRT projections, transformer layers, final normalization, and LM head run in FP16 with FP32 GEMM accumulation. Mamba softplus and recurrent state accumulation remain FP32 to avoid checkpoint-scale overflow. The family-owned grouped RMSNorm fallback is used only when the official kernels are unavailable.
